nodes.label: Hybrid Retrieval Pipeline

nodes.label: EphapticOS Engine
nodes.description: Core cognition and memory engine for transforming unstructured data into actionable knowledge graphs.

nodes.label: Vector Memory Index
nodes.description: Dense embedding index backed by LanceDB or PGVector for hybrid search recall.

nodes.label: Persistent Knowledge Graph
nodes.description: Graph topology stored in Ladybug/Kuzu or Neo4j supporting ontology reasoning.

nodes.label: Multi-Tenancy Isolation
nodes.description: Per-user and per-dataset database isolation enforced when ENABLE_BACKEND_ACCESS_CONTROL is active.

nodes.label: Session Memory Layer
nodes.description: Short-term turn hydration, feedback tuning, and conversational trace capture.

nodes.label: EphapticOS Model Context Protocol
nodes.description: Standardized MCP tools exposing remember, recall, search, and graph traversal over stdio/SSE/HTTP.

nodes.label: FastAPI Client API
nodes.description: Versioned REST endpoints under api/v1/ exposing memory operations, datasets, and permissions.
